STEP 3 - Items: There are 13 grapes in total, 12 red and 1 green. No sauce or oil is visible.

STEP 6 - Grams: The grapes are whole fruit, so I used a bulk density of about 0.7 g/ml. 94 × 0.7 ≈ 66 g, which works out to about 5 g per grape.

STEP 7 - Energy: Grapes provide about 69 kcal per 100 g. 66 g × 0.69 ≈ 46 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Thirteen medium grapes at 4–6 g each come to about 65 g. The estimate is plausible.
